lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Well? Be blunt. It's the only way anyone ever tells me the truth.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: They're brave. And they're not ready. And Yeden doesn't care about the second part.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: No, he doesn't. I'll keep him on a short rope until the plan's in place. A few more weeks, that's all we need.
